premises.text: Indoor growers must tightly control lighting, climate, and related conditions for profits
premises.evidence_span: they have to worry a lot about each and every controllable growing condition. Because being able to control those conditions means being able to control your profits

premises.text: Without integrated data, growers dig through notes, hire consultants, or rely on gut
premises.evidence_span: Tom will end up losing hours digging through his notes to find out what goes wrong. He will spend tons of money, thousands of dollars on consultants

premises.text: Unified data ingestion from hardware sensors, uploads, and manual entry
premises.evidence_span: For the first time, Tom has all of his information in one place

premises.text: Analytics and task views expose yield problems early for sales and operations
premises.evidence_span: the green peppers are expecting low yield because of some low germination rates and problems they had. Now that he has this information, Tom can proactively let his sales team know

premises.text: Energy recommendations exploit time-varying rates for large lighting savings
premises.evidence_span: With our recommendation, Tom can save $150 today, which means he can save $50,000 annually just by turning his lights on or off at different times

premises.text: Per-acre monthly subscription for greenhouse vegetable production
premises.evidence_span: subscription price at $1,000 per acre per month

value.text: Make indoor farming easier by aggregating data and recommending actions
value.evidence_span: Agilis aggregates all of Tom's data in one place. Agilis analyzes and makes recommendations for Tom, saving him money

causal_links.evidence_span: eliminating the guesswork from decision making
provides recommendations to show Tom when he should turn on and off his lights to achieve maximal savings
subscription price at $1,000 per acre per month
